Picture Story · English

Die verschwundene Karte

Beobachte genau, kombiniere die Hinweise und erzähle Lenas Abenteuer auf Englisch. Es gibt nicht nur eine richtige Geschichte.

Niveau A2

Schau dir die sechs Bilder an

Wer? Wo? Was passiert? Wie verändert sich das Wetter?

Leserichtung: 1 → 6
Detektivauftrag: Einige Dinge sieht man direkt, andere muss man erschließen. Formuliere Vermutungen mit maybe, perhaps oder I think … because ….
1

One picture – one sentence

Schreibe zu jedem Bild mindestens einen englischen Satz. Verwende unterschiedliche Satzanfänge.

2

Find the right verb form

Lies den Zusammenhang genau und setze die passende Verbform ein. Die Zeitform musst du selbst erkennen.

Last Saturday, Lena her bicycle into town. Near a bench, a dog after some pigeons. Her map onto the street, but Lena it. At the fountain, she inside her backpack. Tom the map and gave it back. Together, they to the castle, where Lena a wonderful photo.

3

Build a connected story

Wähle einen passenden Verknüpfer. Achte darauf, wie die Gedanken zusammenhängen.

4

Picture detective

Beantworte die Fragen nur mithilfe der Bilder und der sichtbaren Hinweise.

1. Where does Lena first realise that the map is missing?
2. Who has the map when Lena returns to the bench?
3. How does the weather change during the story?
4. What does Lena do at the end?
5

Write the missing dialogue

Was könnten Lena und Tom in Bild 4 sagen? Schreibe eine höfliche, natürliche Unterhaltung.

6

Your complete story

Gib deiner Geschichte einen englischen Titel und schreibe etwa 80–120 Wörter. Du darfst Details erfinden, wenn sie zu den Bildern passen.

Possible dialogue

Lena: “Excuse me, is that my map? I lost it near this bench.”
Tom: “Yes, I think it is yours. I found it on the ground.”

Model story

Last Saturday, Lena rode her bicycle from the station into the old town. She had a yellow backpack and a city map. Near a bench, a playful dog frightened some pigeons. The map fell onto the street, but Lena did not notice it. At the fountain, she opened her backpack and became worried. Then it started to rain. Lena returned to the bench, where Tom was waiting with her map. He gave it back to her. Together they followed the map to the castle. Finally, Lena took a beautiful photo of the rainbow, and both friends felt very happy.
